import json
from auditor_bridge.models import CallbackReceipt, RepositoryLink, ScanImport
from dojo.models import Finding, Test

imports=[]
for row in ScanImport.objects.select_related('test','repository').order_by('created_at'):
    actual=row.test.finding_set.count()
    if actual != row.finding_count:
        raise RuntimeError('Native finding count differs from import receipt')
    imports.append({'scan_id':str(row.scan_id),'test_id':row.test_id,'receipt_finding_count':row.finding_count,'native_finding_count':actual,'commit_sha':row.commit_sha,'repository_id':row.repository.repository_id})
receipts=[]
for row in CallbackReceipt.objects.order_by('created_at'):
    ack=row.acknowledgement
    receipts.append({'callback_id':str(row.callback_id),'scan_id':ack.get('scan_id'),'report_status':ack.get('report_status')})
test_ids=[row['test_id'] for row in imports]
result={'imports':imports,'test_count':len(imports),'finding_count':sum(row['native_finding_count'] for row in imports),'all_native_tests':Test.objects.count(),'all_native_findings':Finding.objects.count(),'native_test_count':Test.objects.filter(id__in=test_ids).count(),'native_finding_count':Finding.objects.filter(test_id__in=test_ids).count(),'callback_receipts':receipts,'repository_links':list(RepositoryLink.objects.order_by('repository_id').values('repository_id','product_id','engagement_id')),'database_counts_match':True}
print('FRESH_NATIVE_JSON='+json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
